messages.subject: vars with different scales
parts:
All
I am plotting variables on the same plot using scaled common ranges.

Given a data.frame from the R data sets: "mtcars" it is simple to scale any one variable

range01<-function(x){
    rng<-range(x,na.rm=TRUE)
   (x-rng[1])/diff(rng)
}

mtcars<-mutate(mtcars,scaledhp=range01(hp))

is there a trivial way to scale hp according to its cylinder (cyl)
without individually scaling and then putting back together in a data.frame
like this:

>cyl4<-mtcars$cyl==4
> only4<-mtcars[cyl4,]
>only4<-mutate(only4,scaledhp=range01(hp))
>cyl6<-mtcars$cyl==6
> only6<-mtcars[cyl6,]
>only6<-mutate(only6,scaledhp=range01(hp))
>new<-rbind(only4,only6)
> str(new)
